description: Turn a pet photo into a short video of the pet doing a move from list_moves: dancing to a song (a dance), or something happening to it with its own sound (an effect). Use it when someone wants their own pet dancing, or in a fun effect, rather than singing. Takes a photo (image_url, or the attached photo; the pet clearly visible, well lit) and a move slug. For a dance whose template_id is required, also send a song from list_song_templates; never send one with an effect. Every pet in the photo takes part. Costs 1 credit. It returns at once with a video id: poll get_video_status about every 10 seconds until it is completed (usually about a minute).

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to a photo of the pet. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 15MB. Send this or photo.

move.description: The slug of a dance or effect, from list_moves.

photo.description: A photo the person attached in the chat. ChatGPT fills this in; other clients send image_url.

template_id.description: Dances only: the song to dance to, from list_song_templates. Required when the move's template_id is required, optional when the dance has its own song (it replaces it), refused for effects.

name: create_move_video
title: Make a pet dance, or put it in an effect
